name: Evergreen Marine Corporation (Taiwan) Ltd.
summary: Evergreen Marine Corporation (Taiwan) Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the shipping carrier and agency, container terminal operations, and commercial port area ship repair businesses in Taiwan, North America, Europe, Asia, and internationally.
